rules.id: MaxPreps teamId GUID (team-context teamId == standings schoolId)
rules.name: MaxPreps schoolName (no "High School"), except Southwest (MaxPreps "Southwest SD")
rules.acronym: team-context schoolNameAcronym verbatim (equal to the standings row where one exists)
rules.mascot/city: team-context schoolMascot (trimmed) / schoolCity; Mission Vista mascot from the school site (see its notes)
rules.colors: standings row schoolColor1/2 where the team has a 26-27 row; else team-context schoolColor1/2 (identical fields; verified equal for all 34 SoCal teams with both). Uppercase hex, no #.
rules.colorSource: "maxpreps-standings" for all 50 (the enum is maxpreps-standings | placeholder; placeholder means invented colours). Prospect precedent in registry-seed.json.
rules.maxprepsPath: path of team-context canonicalUrl (== standings teamCanonicalUrl where a row exists)
rules.sblive*: harvested only, never guessed; every one of the 50 matched by name + city on si.com; SDS slugs cross-checked against sds_team_table.md
rules.aliases: name, NAME, "<name> High School" (not for Bishop's, La Jolla Country Day and the two Academies, whose real names are not "<name> High School"), "<name> <mascot>" (MaxPreps mascot, plus si.com's where it differs), MaxPreps schoolName if different, MaxPreps formattedName without ", CA" when it carries a city, si.com/CIFSDS-alignment spellings; no 2-letter tokens; checked against all 99 teams with lib/teams.ts normalizeTeamKey (see seeds/check_seeds.py)

sbliveIdentity.ambiguousNamesNote: si.com namesakes: TWO "Westview" teams (ours 458949 San Diego; 464882 Westview Wildcats, West Los Angeles, bucket 4223-mulholland, 2 games) -> resolve Westview by team/school id, and consider adding "Westview" to STATEWIDE_AMBIGUOUS. "Del Norte": the Crescent City school is a MaxPreps ghost (DATA_QUALITY.ghostTeamIds), and the si.com team search (nameSearch) also lists a Crescent City Del Norte (458609), so "Del Norte" resolves by id only. "University" (Irvine 458756) is never an alias of University City. Canyon Hills (459034) and Mt. Carmel (458939) are in no si.com league bucket. Every sbliveSchoolId is harvested (logo URL or team page school.id, see schoolIdSource).

nameSearch.method: https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/california/field-hockey/teams?name={name} (the search the EAL used, DATA-SOURCES §1.2 caveat 9), fetched 2026-10-06 with a browser User-Agent, one request at a time at least 600 ms apart, for the 50 names and the spellings Southwest SD, Mt Carmel, Bishops, Canyon Crest, San Dieguito, LJCD and RBV
nameSearch.result: Every name returned exactly one team of that name except these, whose normalized names are added to STATEWIDE_AMBIGUOUS (lib/sources/sblive.ts), so a si.com side with that name resolves only by its si.com team or school id. Fuzzy matches under other names (e.g. Bonita Vista for Bonita, Claremont for Clairemont) are not namesakes.
